customManagers.description: Tool versions pinned in workflows behind a '# renovate:' comment. An optional *_SHA256 line directly below the version is captured as the digest and updated in the same PR (needs a datasource with release-asset digests, e.g. github-release-attachments).

packageRules.description: mcp-publisher is verified against a pinned sha256; Renovate updates it, CI re-checks it
prBodyNotes: This PR must change `MCP_PUBLISHER_SHA256` in `.github/workflows/release.yml` along with the version. The `mcp-publisher-pin` CI check downloads the tarball and fails if the hash does not match.

packageRules.description: Immediately open PRs for vulnerability fixes
